  have hcd2 : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioo x1 x2) :=

  have hc2_in : c2 ∈ Set.Ioi a := lt_trans hax1 hc2.1
  have hc1_le_c2 : c1 ≤ c2 := le_trans (le_of_lt hc1.2) (le_of_lt hc2.1)
